ItemID: NA; Title: Exile On Main Street Remastered; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its bluesy rock fits my Clapton and Hendrix listening, but I would pass on a remaster this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Lovin' Spoonful - Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy pop sounds appealing, though it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Beatles Live Hollywood Bowl; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in studio songs than a live Beatles recording right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Dylan, Cash, and the Nashville Cats: A New Music City; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country and roots connections interest me, but I would skip a broad compilation today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wanted The Outlaws 1976-1996 20th Anniversary; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in Blown Away makes country worth considering, but outlaw country is a less certain fit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Neil Diamond All Time Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am leaning toward blues and roots rock rather than polished pop hits today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Corazon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Santana's guitar playing interests me, but I am less sure about this album's Latin pop direction.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Beatles; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Their songwriting fits some of my rock interests, but the title alone does not give me enough reason to choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Jackson Browne's reflective songwriting feels like a good follow-up to You Should Be So Lucky; this is the one I would try.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blackstar; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its experimental direction is outside the straightforward roots and blues sound I want today.
